targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', d.start_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
  COUNT(*) AS "Drives",
  ROUND(SUM(d.distance)::numeric, 1) AS "Distance km",
  ROUND(SUM(d.duration_min)::numeric) AS "Duration min",
  ROUND((SUM(d.distance) / NULLIF(SUM(d.duration_min), 0) * 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Speed km/h",
  ROUND(MAX(d.speed_max)::numeric) AS "Top Speed km/h",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charging_sessions cs
   WHERE cs.vehicle_id = d.vehicle_id
     AND DATE_TRUNC('month', cs.start_date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', d.start_date)) AS "Charges",
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(cs2.charge_energy_added)::numeric, 1) FROM charging_sessions cs2
   WHERE cs2.vehicle_id = d.vehicle_id
     AND DATE_TRUNC('month', cs2.start_date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', d.start_date)) AS "Energy kWh",
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(cs3.cost)::numeric, 2) FROM charging_sessions cs3
   WHERE cs3.vehicle_id = d.vehicle_id
     AND DATE_TRUNC('month', cs3.start_date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', d.start_date)
     AND cs3.cost IS NOT NULL) AS "Cost $"
FROM drives d
WHERE d.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', d.start_date), d.vehicle_id
ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', d.start_date) DESC
